2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a bug where atomic VMA flags are lost due to races between operations that snapshot VMA flags and the setting of VM_MAYBE_GUARD atomically under the VMA read lock. The patches add tests to verify this issue, which is fixed by ensuring that VMA flags are not dropped when set atomically. The series includes four patches: three core patches and a test patch. The test patch adds a selftest to demonstrate the bug and its fix.
